# Why did my Shopify product import fail?

> Free Shopify product CSV checker: finds blank handles, split products, duplicate variants, bad prices, wrong barcode check digits, broken image URLs, Excel-damaged SKUs and semicolon files, with line numbers, and applies safe fixes. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
